items.text: when a shelf's door or the ring's panel dot opens a panel or the index, its edge glows blue twice, so you see where you went
the ring's mark sits beside the bug button, with the Steer it path's dot: tap it for the ring and how to open it yourself. Once you have opened the ring twice on your own, it goes
the ring opens like a flower, in three quick pops from your finger, the labels arriving last; a choice swells, the others fold away, then it slides home
a second ring, Play: back, robot, next, dice, capture, and two values you drag, volume and flow (the number shows inside the dot; tap it for a slider in the middle)
the ring's name in the middle has a grip to move the ring and a switch between Touch and Play; the last ring you used opens next time
the Touch ring has its mark (six dots round a centre), a key (q), a first step in the Steer it path, and a show me on the Touch page
Batch has one scroll, not two: the list of scenes or texts is part of the panel, and the make button stays at its foot
in the mixer the master stays at the foot on a phone; the sounds scroll above it
M and S say what they do: on hover, and in the caption when tapped (mute: this one is silent; solo: only this one plays)
the Founders Club backdrop is a soft, even veil (no dark rim, never solid)
feedback in the report sheet wears a smile instead of the bug
after an update, a slow first start no longer restarts the page (the duck came down twice)
with a mouse, right-click the stage for the Touch ring, where the pointer is

the Touch ring. Double-tap the stage and a ring of dots opens where your finger is: push, steer, magnet or off (a finger does nothing, for performing), touchable sound, and the Touch panel. Steer and magnet moved here from Tools
the picture button is In now, an arrow into a tray: picture, video and camera as before, then G-code, a sound, a pack and the mic
the Sound panel plays and shapes (mic, mixer, water, beat grid, bytes, react). Pack is In's panel, touchable sound is Touch's
every shelf ends with a door to its full panel, the same everywhere; Tools' door is the index
